name: io.github.akshayharti/ntfsmnt
description: Mount macOS NTFS volumes read-write with ntfs-3g. Read tools run anywhere; every mount, unmount, or eject needs a narrow, expiring grant a human approves in the browser. FUSE-T and ntfs-3g are host prerequisites, not included in the package.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.notes: recover and remove_hiberfile are never grantable and stay human-only.
